pages.title: Ancient YunLai Swordmanship
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Swords$(br2)§lEffect: §r Attack Speed +5.0, Attack Reach +5.0 blocks, Damage ×1.50; hits have a 75% chance to launch a golden sword-qi, with Damage ×0.75 and a 10-block range.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Loot Chests and Villager Trades only (Treasure)$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with YunLai Swordmanship and other melee damage/growth-type enchantments; only one may be applied to a weapon.
